slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: On-chain resolution outcomes for every market in the sample: the fill-conditional loss rate's Wilson 95% upper bound is below break-even for the traded band…
Held-out backtest versus the random-time ask-buy control: PnL per capital-day bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero under the worst-case queue model.
